fields.v: Page numbers are PDF pages (printed journal pages 46-64). Extends the authors' earlier overview [23]. Mentions a 'companion repository' with a worked example but gives no URL in text. Reporting inconsistencies: the coding matrix is called 'Table 2' in the text (p 8) but is Table 3 (Table 2 is the rubric); the conclusion places the benchmark interpretation problem in 'Section 4' but it is Section 5 (p 15); the matrix is dated 'early 2026' (p 9) but Table 4 'mid-2026' (p 10); the abstract says the memory comparison covers write-policy visibility and traceability, but Table 5 has only artefact- and procedural-memory columns (p 1, 11). Claims partly supported by cited vendor reports and preprints; no empirical data
